review_comment: Since this is a breaking change, we should add something to the release notes at the minimum, though maybe we don't change the name at all? People can have existing configuration that uses `watchos_arm64` to mean the simulator, and some rulesets would have to do a version check or something similar to get the right version of this: https://github.com/buildbuddy-io/rules_xcodeproj/blob/47d9510b64878ae1893d355cbf134d6a4b6eb715/xcodeproj/internal/xcodeproj_rule.bzl#L490-L493

> Since this is a breaking change, we should add something to the release notes at the minimum, though maybe we don't change the name at all?

I think breaking change would be suitable for 6.0.0 release? 👀 I wanted to be consistent with the other names, otherwise it can get confusing.
It's the best time to break it, yes, but I was also starting how it's tricky for rulesets to do things based on the bazel version.
